Pier 4 is a beautiful waterfront multi-family complex located at the end of Columbia Road (next door to The Stairs) in the fashionable Back Bay neighborhood of Beacon Hill in Boston. Developed in 1978-80, it offers studio to five bedroom condominiums overlooking the Charles River and the islands, set at the back of a landscaped, private garden courtyard and featuring two elevators.
The 30-foot-wide water frontage consists of six levels, designed for residents with a sense of adventure and for those interested in the sea - with their ability to walk out the sliding glass doors to explore the ocean and all that it has to offer from the back yard patios and private balconies. There are 19 waterfront units, including four duplexes, one being a third floor unit. Pier 4 also features a club house with exercise rooms and a solarium furnished with leather upholstery and a sunken hot tub.
